title: Open-Air Minibus Sightseeing Tour of Nashville
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Let our experienced 5-star tour guide take you on a memorable sightseeing tour around Nashville. This 90 minute tour is not only going to highlight all the main attractions that the Music City is famous for but also those special places that only a local can share with you. Xperience Nashville offers you a comfortable open-air ride that offers great views. As the most affordable tour in town you won't be disappointed. Looking to book the whole bus, call us directly.
